title: infrastructure-weekly-update-2026-07-20
content:
Redwood Inference — Infrastructure weekly update (2026-07-20)
Owner: Priya Narang (eng-infrastructure)
Collaborators: Evan Miller, Lucia Gomez, Samir Rao
Status: final

High level summary
- Stable week overall; one short degradation event (scheduler bug) on 2026-07-18 that affected a subset of Hosted API requests in us-west1 for ~10 minutes. Full mitigation completed and rollback applied.
- GPU pool utilization steady but trending up as Dedicated onboarding tests increased sustained throughput.
- Region expansion: APAC pilot plan (asia-southeast1) approved; procurement and networking kickoff next week.
- Capacity ask: we are projecting incremental H100 capacity needs for late Aug/Sept driven by 2 upcoming Dedicated customers and an expected Q3 usage ramp.

Key metrics (week of Jul 13-19)
- Total GPU capacity (logical): 1,280 H100-equivalent slots (includes partial T4/A10 as smaller jobs)
- Average GPU utilization: 64% cluster-wide (target SLO for avg <= 75%)
- Peak single-region utilization: us-east1 84% (short-lived bursts during canary traffic)
- Average request latency (hosted API, text-gen): p95 = 320ms, p99 = 780ms
- Incident count: 1 (see incident section)

GPU fleet status
- H100 pool: healthy. Minor noisy-neighbor hotspots on rack 9 in us-east1 — identified as a hypervisor scheduling contention issue. Patch scheduled for 2026-07-22 (INFRA-3478).
- A100 fallbacks: ready and warm in us-west1 for immediate fallback when H100 pool is constrained. Observed ~7% performance delta on model X-13 at 2k tokens; acceptable under fallback policy.
- T4/A10 pool: used mostly for embeddings and light workloads; utilization 52%. No issues.
- Firmware/driver updates: rolling NV driver update completed for us-east1 (no regressions observed). Next roll: us-west1 (canary on 2026-07-21).

Regions & networking
- us-east1: highest sustained utilization this week. Working with SRE on pre-warming strategy for canary traffic windows to reduce p99 spikes.
- us-west1: incident on 7/18 primarily surfaced there due to scheduler bug in the job-router. Canary rollout of scheduler fix (PR #1284) prevented larger outage — full rollout scheduled 7/21 after canary verification.
- europe-west1: stable, spare capacity ~28% this week. Good candidate for burst routing.
- asia-southeast1 (APAC pilot): procurement approved. Next steps: networking/design kickoff (vpc peering, transit gateway), compliance checklist (data locality + KMS), timeline estimate 8-10 weeks if spot procurement succeeds.

Incidents & postmortem (short)
- Incident: scheduler-induced request queueing (2026-07-18 14:03-14:13 UTC)
  - Impact: minority of hosted text-gen requests in us-west1 saw ~3-4x latency increase; no data loss.
  - Root cause: regression in job-router introduced by recent change to backpressure heuristics (INFRA-3421).
  - Mitigation: rolled back change, restarted router fleet, adjusted throttling thresholds.
  - Follow-ups: detailed postmortem draft (INFRA-3421) assigned to Evan M.; action to add additional canary/metric (queue length per-host) before future router heuristic changes.

Capacity planning & forecasts
- Q3 projection (conservative): +15-20% aggregate token demand across Hosted and Dedicated by end of Aug.
- Dedicated pipeline: two medium-large contracts expected to convert in Aug that combined would require ~200 additional H100-equivalent slots during business hours.
- Procurement ask: start formal RFP for 200 H100s + spares (target order placement by 2026-07-30). Reason: lead times on chassis + racks are trending 4-6 weeks.
- Short-term mitigations: enable cross-region burst routing + temporarily increase A100 fallback capacity in us-east/us-west; negotiate temporary burst from cloud partner for late-Aug test windows.

Operational work & engineering progress
- Scheduler/router improvements: PR #1284 landed in canary; telemetry added for queue length and per-host backpressure. Can be toggled via runtime flag. Owner: Samir R.
- Autoscaler tuning: updated policy to prefer preserving warm cache (do not scale-in below 30% idle on GPU pools with >24h warm KV cache). Testing in staging next week. Owner: Lucia G.
- Observability: added trace/span tags for model-variant fallback decisions to simplify troubleshooting when we route to A100. Owner: Evan M.
- Runbook updates: Incident runbook updated with explicit rollback steps for router heuristics and a checklist for safe driver upgrades.

Hiring & headcount notes
- New hire: offer extended to 1 infra SRE candidate (start date projected 2026-08-15).
- Still hiring: 1 infra SWE for scheduler/placement (reopen req due to candidate drop).

Risks & open questions
- Procurement lead times continue to be a gating risk for H100 scale-up. Do we have budget flexibility to secure earlier delivery (capex reallocation)?
- APAC networking: Are there any outstanding compliance items from security that will lengthen the pilot beyond current 8-10 week estimate? Requesting security review by 2026-07-24.
- Fallback performance: need a small eval matrix for model families to quantify P50/P95 deltas when falling back to A100s — owner: ML infra to produce by 2026-07-27.

Action items (next week)
- Evan M.: complete incident postmortem (INFRA-3421) and attach to Confluence page by 2026-07-22.
- Samir R.: complete full rollout of router fix (PR #1284) after canary verification and update runbook by 2026-07-21.
- Lucia G.: run autoscaler staging tests and report results in next update (2026-07-27).
- Priya N.: start RFP process for 200 H100s; coordinate with finance for budget approval by 2026-07-30.
- ML infra (TBD): deliver fallback perf matrix for top 6 production models by 2026-07-27.

Notes / loose thoughts (notes-to-self style)
- Consider temporary reservation of cloud partner capacity for late-Aug + early-Sept tests — talk to partnerships.
- Revisit canary cadence for router heuristics after this incident; maybe add incremental toggles instead of full heuristic flips.
- Keep an eye on electricity/cooling on rack 9 (hypervisor noise) — might be a hardware-level throttle.

Attachments & refs
- Confluence: capacity plan Q3: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INFRA/capacity-plan-Q3-2026
- JIRA: INFRA-3421 (scheduler incident), INFRA-3478 (rack hypervisor contention)
- GitHub: PR #1284 (router fix)

-- end of update --
